presets.doc_intro: Theme presets are small "brand kits": one attribute swaps a screen's shape (radius) and accent, layered over styles.css. They compose with theme (light/dark) and density, and can scope to a subtree — so a marketing section can feel different from the app around it. Presets only override role tokens; they add no new base tokens.
presets.usage_desc: Use the WimProvider prop (recommended) or set the attribute directly — same contract as theme and density.
presets.list_desc: Accent text (links) stays AA-contrast in both themes; solid fills keep white text. Minimal changes shape only and keeps the default accent.
presets.extend_desc: Presets are generated from tokens/presets/*.json (radius + PCCS-referenced accents) into a [data-wim-preset] CSS layer by npm run tokens:build. Add a file, rebuild, and it appears in WIM_PRESETS and the preset type.
